## Guidance

- Verbatim (Outlook): "However, the adverse implications of the extended disruption in supply chains and elevated energy prices could interrupt the growth momentum. Inflation is expected to trend higher from its relatively benign levels, driven by higher food, energy prices, weather-related uncertainties, and currency depreciation."
- Verbatim (Outlook): "Against this ever changing economic and geopolitical landscape, the Company remains committed to delivering sustainable shareholder value by leveraging sector specific technology, investing in AI, and adopt digital solutions to enhance productivity and competitiveness."
- No numeric FY27 guidance in this filing.

## Management Commentary — Demand

- Verbatim (CMD): "The financial year has commenced against the backdrop of geopolitical uncertainties. The Company has managed to maintain momentum by rotating its focus across sectors and geographies while maintaining robust cash flows."
- Verbatim (Infrastructure & Utilities): "receipt of orders for Residential & Commercial buildings and Ferrous Metal projects."
- Verbatim (Energy – Green): "The growth is on account of receipt of ultra-mega orders in the Offshore Wind business."
- Verbatim (Energy – Conventional): "The decline reflects the deferment of certain anticipated orders and the high base effect arising from an ultra-mega order secured in the CarbonLite Solutions business in the corresponding period of the previous year."
- Verbatim (Financial Services): "primarily driven by focused and higher disbursements in the retail business."

## Management Commentary — Margins

- Verbatim (Infrastructure & Utilities): "The contraction in margin is primarily on account of change in revenue mix and an increase in credit provisions on account of expected delays in collection of receivables."
- Verbatim (Technology, Platforms & Services): "The marginal decline is reflective of higher manpower cost and forex variation adversely impacting hedged portfolio positions."
- Verbatim (Manufacturing & Products): "The margin is reflective of change in the sales mix within the portfolio."
- Verbatim (Realty): "The decline in margin is primarily due to the change in sales composition."

## Management Commentary — Capacity / Expansion

- Verbatim (CMD): "During the quarter, we successfully concluded the sale of Nabha Power Limited, consistent with our stated strategy of exiting the concessions portfolio. Further, we have signed the share purchase agreement with Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited ("HMRL"), a Government of Telangana Enterprise, to divest 100% of our stake in Hyderabad Metro SPV."
- Verbatim (Segment realignment): "Effective from April 01, 2026, pursuant to the Company's Lakshya 2031 strategic plan, the Group has realigned its portfolio to enhance strategic focus, capital allocation efficiency and operational agility."
- Verbatim (Scheme rationale): "As the Transferor Company has ceased to carry on its core business operations and is an intermediate company, the residual assets, investments and contractual and other rights and obligations will seamlessly vest in the Transferee Company resulting in enhanced operational clarity and legal certainty."

## Named Catalysts

- Scheme of Amalgamation of L&T Power Development Limited (wholly owned subsidiary) with the Company, subject to shareholder/creditor approval and NCLT Mumbai sanction. No effective date stated in this filing.
- Verbatim: "The Scheme is subject to the necessary approvals including sanction by the Mumbai bench of the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal ("NCLT")."
- Hyderabad Metro SPV stake sale to HMRL (share purchase agreement signed; see CMD quote above). Completion timing not stated in this filing.
- Verbatim (Financial Services): "healthy asset quality and strong operating performance" supported PBT growth.

## Named Risks

- Verbatim (Outlook): "the adverse implications of the extended disruption in supply chains and elevated energy prices could interrupt the growth momentum."
- Verbatim (Outlook): "In energy markets, the resurgence of geopolitical tensions in West Asia and continued uncertainty around global trade policies remains key risks."
- Verbatim (Infrastructure & Utilities): "an increase in credit provisions on account of expected delays in collection of receivables."
- Verbatim (Energy – Green): "largely due to supply chain disruptions arising from the West Asia conflict in the Solar business."
